System Protection
\n

A simple recovery centre for protecting M&O operational records. Backup copies are restricted to Partners/Admins.

\n\n
\n
\n
BACKUP STATUS
\n
Checking…
\n
Last successful backup: —
\n
\n
\n
DATABASE
\n
Connected
\n
Operational data is stored in Supabase.
\n
\n
\n
EXTERNAL COPY
\n
Manual Download
\n
Keep downloaded backups outside MOLMS.
\n
\n
\n\n
Backup & Recovery
\n
\n
\n
\n
Full System Backup
\n
Creates a private logical snapshot of all MOLMS database tables plus account metadata, then provides a copy you can keep outside the system.
\n
\n \n
\n
\n
Backup files contain confidential law-firm information. Store downloaded copies securely. Supabase platform-managed backups, if enabled on the project plan, remain separate from this MOLMS backup.
\n
\n\n
\n
Backup History
\n \n
\n
\n
Loading backup history…
\n
\n\n
Recovery
\n
\n
Controlled Restore Only
\n
MOLMS deliberately has no one-click reset or full-data wipe. If recovery is required, download the required backup and restore it through a controlled administrator procedure after integrity checks.
\n
\n\n
Data Export
\n

For reporting or offline reference only. Data exports are not system backups.

\n
\n \n \n
\n
\n\n \n
Restricted Administration
\n

Partner/Admin only. Destructive actions require a successful backup from the last 24 hours, password re-authentication and exact typed confirmation.

\n
\n ⚠ Advanced Reset & Wipe Controls\n
\n
\n
System Reset
\n

Clears operational records while preserving users, access roles, HR employee master data, bank setup, statutory configuration and backup history.

\n \n
\n
\n
Full Operational Data Wipe
\n

Removes all operational/business records and core HR/financial setup. User access, security roles and backup history are preserved so recovery remains possible.

\n \n
\n
\n
Neither action deletes protected MOLMS backup files or your Partner/Admin access.
\n
\n\n
\n
\n
\n
\n
A successful MOLMS backup less than 24 hours old is mandatory. The action is recorded in the system administration audit log.
